item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 22/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Prapiroon will move across Hainan Island and enter Beibu Wan today. It will then move towards the vicinity of Guangxi to the northern part of Vietnam and weaken gradually. The associated squally showers and thunderstorms will affect the coast of Guangdong today. It will be windier over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Gaemi will move in the general direction of the seas east of Taiwan and intensify significantly in the next couple of days. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather over southeastern China will be very hot with a few showers midweek this week. A southwesterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week, bringing unsettled weather to the region.
